subject: MAP weekly checkpoint — security closure tasks & audit timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Tyler Quinn <tq@acmepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly checkpoint — security closure tasks & audit timeline

Hi Tyler / Acme team,

Thanks for taking time yesterday. Per our mutual action plan (MAP) we pulled the outstanding security asks into a short tracker and owners for this week's closure push. This note summarizes status, owners, blockers, and proposed close dates so we can align on the final evaluation window.

Top-line status
- SOC 2: evidence inventory largely complete, outstanding controls documentation for CC6 and CC7.
- DPA: Acme redlines received; legal to confirm a few reciprocal obligations.
- Audit logs: engineering can enable extended retention by next sprint but need production schedule coordination.
- Pen test: vendor scope proposal attached; we recommend a scoped external pen test after the feature freeze (ETA below).

Action items (owners & ETA)
1) SOC 2 evidence upload: Marcus Lin — updated tracker by 2028-07-02 (attachment: SOC2-evidence-tracker.xlsx).
2) DPA redlines response: Karthik Iyer — internal markups by 2028-06-30; send to Acme legal for review 2028-07-01 (attachment: DPA-redlines-v2.docx).
3) Audit log retention change: Neha Kapoor & Eng infra (request submitted) — schedule change window 2028-07-09 to avoid maintenance blackout.
4) Pen test scoping & PO: Soojin Lee — finalize vendor scope and submit for procurement by 2028-07-05 (attachment: pen-test-scope-proposal.pdf).

Meeting notes (from 2028-06-27 sync)
- Acme requested a specific log field (payment_token_id) be included in audit exports for the SOC 2 sample — engineering confirmed possible but needs throughput testing.
- DPA: Acme legal requested a clause to clarify subprocessor list timing (we suggested quarterly updates).

Blockers / asks for Acme
- Can Acme confirm the acceptable window for pen test (targeting mid-July) and any IP/scope exclusions?
- Please confirm whether a single signed DPA is sufficient for procurement to proceed (Procurement team cc'd).

I'll update the tracker after Karthik and Marcus push their items. Proposed next checkpoint: 2028-07-04 (end of week) — 15 min readout.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Head, Commercial Security
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0118

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32kb); DPA-redlines-v2.docx (docx, 18kb); pen-test-scope-proposal.pdf (pdf, 210kb)

From: Tyler Quinn <tq@acmepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmepay.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP weekly checkpoint — security closure tasks & audit timeline

Thanks Soojin — helpful summary. A few quick clarifications:

1) Pen test window: mid-July works for Acme, but we need July 16-20 blocked out (we're busy July 9-13). Can you confirm vendor availability?
2) Audit logs: adding payment_token_id is fine; can you include an example export so our audit team can validate sample format?
3) DPA: Our procurement needs the DPA signed to kick the PO. We can accept the DPA with your 30-day subprocessor update cadence, but legal will want that in writing.

I'll coordinate with procurement to confirm whether they need anything else to issue a PO once the DPA is signed.

Thanks,
Tyler
Tyler Quinn | Head of Integrations, Acme Payments
tq@acmepay.com
Phone: +1 (212) 555-0199
